summary.text: Julie Fahey is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 14 who took office in January 2017, has served as Speaker of the House since March 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Republican Kevin Burton as her general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Fahey was born in Morris, Illinois, in 1978 and received a bachelor's degree from the University of Notre Dame in 2000.
She was a business consultant and co-founder of a human resources consulting firm for businesses and nonprofits.
Fahey chaired the Lane County Democratic Party from 2012 to 2014 and was treasurer of the Democratic Party of Oregon from 2015 to 2017.
She was elected to the House in 2016 and assumed office on January 9, 2017.
In the House she chaired the Housing Committee (2021-2022) and the Rules Committee (2023-2024), and she served as majority leader from 2022 to 2024.
She became speaker on March 7, 2024, replacing Dan Rayfield, who resigned to campaign for Oregon attorney general.
